_readme: عقد التوافق البايتي لطبقة التعمية (electron/mobilecrypto.js §4.1). على PWA أن تعيد إنتاج derived و frames حرفياً بـWebCrypto. كل الحقول الثنائية بترميز base64url بلا حشو.

algorithms.ecdh: raw shared secret = X coordinate, 32 bytes (WebCrypto deriveBits ECDH 256)
algorithms.cipher: AES-256-GCM, 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag appended to ciphertext

frame.layout: version(1) || dir(1) || counter(8, big-endian) || ciphertext || tag(16)
frame.replay_rule: receiver accepts only strictly increasing counters (gaps allowed)

webcrypto_notes: private key: importKey('jwk', {kty:'EC', crv:'P-256', d, x, y}) where x = public[1..33], y = public[33..65]
hkdf keys: deriveBits({name:'HKDF', hash:'SHA-256', salt, info:utf8('satr-mobile-v1')}, ikm, 512) -> key_d2m||key_m2d
hkdf nonce prefixes: a SECOND deriveBits with info:utf8('satr-mobile-v1-nonce') and length 64 -> prefix_d2m||prefix_m2d
aes-gcm: additionalData = header, tagLength = 128; WebCrypto appends the tag, matching this layout
pair_id must be unique per session: it is the HKDF salt and the counter restarts at 0

sas.rule: decimal(first 20 bits of SHA-256(desktop_public || mobile_public || utf8(pair_id))) % 1e6, padded to 6
